chunks: Indeed, the gazes of these covetous ones are reaching out
and that is the cause of its glancing; so when any one of you looks at a woman who attracts him, let him touch his wife, for she is a woman like that woman.
ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ali advise men to control lustful gazes according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this counsel from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) addresses the psychological mechanism of lust, identifying the 'covetous gaze' as the root cause of lingering desire. He prescribes conjugal intimacy not merely as a distraction, but as a means of grounding the mind in familiar reality, thereby neutralizing the novelty of the stranger. This teaching aligns with the Shia emphasis on practical spiritual hygiene, where physical actions are used to recalibrate the heart's focus.

en.sayed-ali-raza: The eyes of these men are covetous and this glancing is the cause of their becoming covetous.
Whenever anyone of you sees a woman who attracts him, he should meet his wife because she is a woman like his wife.
